block.edit_fields.model.title: Edit Fields
block.edit_fields.model.description: Set, rename, copy or remove fields of each JSON message without code.
block.edit_fields.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.edit_fields.order_hint: Operations run in order, top to bottom, each on the result of the previous ones.
block.edit_fields.help_mode: edit starts from the received message and applies the operations. keep_only starts from an empty object: only the fields that set and copy write are output, copy reading the received message.
block.edit_fields.help_apply_to: message edits the whole message. each_item edits every element of a JSON array, in order, and outputs the edited array; paths are then relative to each element.
block.edit_fields.help_array_path: Where the array is in the message, with the path syntax of operations. Leave empty when the message itself is the array.
block.edit_fields.help_max_items: Largest array accepted, from 1 to 10000. A longer array fails the activation; it is never truncated.
block.edit_fields.help_on_missing: When the source of copy, rename or remove, or a template reference, does not resolve: skip leaves that operation out (a trace says so); fail stops the activation.
block.edit_fields.help_parse_json: auto parses text that is valid JSON and keeps other text as a JSON string; always requires JSON; never keeps the received text as a JSON string (message only).
block.edit_fields.help_on_error: fail stops the activation without publishing anything; route publishes a JSON error document on error instead, and nothing on out. A partial result is never published.
block.edit_fields.help_path: path: names separated by dots, [index] for array items and ["name"] for names with dots, brackets or surrounding spaces, e.g. customer.email, items[0].price or headers["content-type"]. Empty means the whole message, or the whole item with each_item. Missing names are created as objects.
block.edit_fields.help_from_to: from and to (copy, rename): source and target paths, with the same syntax. In keep_only, copy reads the received message; rename and remove change the result being built.
block.edit_fields.help_value_type: value_type: string, number (kept exactly as written), boolean, null, json (any JSON value) or template (text with references).
block.edit_fields.help_value: In a template, {reference} inserts the value at that path of the received message, never an edited one; a template made of one reference keeps its JSON type. Write {escape} for literal braces.
block.edit_fields.help_sample: Edited like a received text message with the settings being edited, including unapplied changes. Nothing is saved, sent or run.
block.edit_fields.card_invalid: Invalid settings: open the block to fix them.
block.edit_fields.message_failed: The message could not be edited: {reason}
block.edit_fields.fix_errors: Not applied: fix the highlighted settings first.
block.edit_fields.preview_invalid: Fix the highlighted settings to test them.
block.edit_fields.preview_success: The edited message; nothing was saved or sent.
block.edit_fields.preview_items.one: {count} item edited; nothing was saved or sent.
block.edit_fields.preview_items.other: {count} items edited; nothing was saved or sent.
block.edit_fields.preview_failed: The activation would fail and publish nothing (on_error fail).
block.edit_fields.preview_routed: Nothing would be published on out; this document would be published on error (on_error route).
block.edit_fields.preview_truncated: Long texts are shortened here; the run publishes them whole.
block.edit_fields.skipped_items_line.one: Operation {index} ({label}) skipped on {count} item, first at item [{item}]: {reason}
block.edit_fields.skipped_items_line.oth: Operation {index} ({label}) skipped on {count} items, first at item [{item}]: {reason}
block.edit_fields.err_config_type: The settings must be a JSON object.
block.edit_fields.err_mode_invalid: mode must be edit or keep_only.
block.edit_fields.err_apply_to_invalid: apply_to must be message or each_item.
block.edit_fields.err_on_missing_invalid: on_missing must be skip or fail.
block.edit_fields.err_parse_json_invalid: parse_json must be auto, always or never.
block.edit_fields.err_on_error_invalid: on_error must be fail or route.
block.edit_fields.err_max_items_invalid: max_items must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
block.edit_fields.err_each_item_needs_js: each_item reads the message as JSON: choose parse_json auto or always.
block.edit_fields.err_operations_type: operations must be a list of operation objects.
block.edit_fields.err_operation_type: Each operation must be an object.
block.edit_fields.err_op_invalid: op must be set, copy, rename, remove, default or append.
block.edit_fields.err_rename_root: rename needs a field: {field} cannot be empty.
block.edit_fields.err_remove_root: remove needs a field: path cannot be empty.
block.edit_fields.err_same_path: from and to are the same path.
block.edit_fields.err_path_invalid: {field} is not a valid path: separate names with dots, use [index] for array items and ["name"] for names with dots or brackets, for example items[0].price.
block.edit_fields.err_path_spaces: A name in {field} starts or ends with a space: write it as ["name"].
block.edit_fields.err_array_path_invalid: {field} is not a valid path: separate names with dots, use [index] for array items and ["name"] for names with dots or brackets, for example items[0].price.
block.edit_fields.err_array_path_spaces: A name in {field} starts or ends with a space: write it as ["name"].
block.edit_fields.err_value_type_invalid: value_type must be string, number, boolean, null, json or template.
block.edit_fields.err_value_not_string: value must be text for value_type {value_type}.
block.edit_fields.err_value_not_number: value must be a JSON number such as 42, -0.5, 12.50 or 1e3.
block.edit_fields.err_value_not_boolean: value must be true or false.
block.edit_fields.err_value_not_json: value must be standard JSON text, for example {example}, [1,2] or "text".
block.edit_fields.err_template_unclosed: A template reference opened with {open} has no closing {close}; write {escape} for literal braces.
block.edit_fields.err_template_empty: A template reference is empty: write a path between {open} and {close}.
block.edit_fields.err_template_reference: The template reference {reference} is not a valid path.
block.edit_fields.err_template_too_many: A template holds at most {max} references.
block.edit_fields.err_message_too_large: the message is larger than {max} bytes.
block.edit_fields.err_message_not_json: the message is not valid JSON and parse_json is always.
block.edit_fields.err_message_not_text: the message is not text or JSON.
block.edit_fields.err_too_deep: the value nests more than {max} levels.
block.edit_fields.err_result_too_deep: the result nests more than {max} levels.
block.edit_fields.err_array_path_missing: array_path does not resolve in the message.
block.edit_fields.err_array_path_not_arr: the value at array_path is not a JSON array.
block.edit_fields.err_not_array: the message is not a JSON array.
block.edit_fields.err_too_many_items: the array has {count} items, more than max_items ({max}).
block.edit_fields.err_reference_missing: the template reference {reference} does not resolve in the input.
block.edit_fields.err_path_blocked: cannot write at {path}: {at} is of type {found}, not {expected}.
block.edit_fields.err_index_out_of_range: cannot write at {path}: index [{position}] is past the end of the array at {at} ({length} item(s)).
block.edit_fields.err_append_not_array: cannot append at {path}: it is of type {found}, not array.
block.edit_fields.err_output_too_large: the result is larger than {max} bytes.
block.edit_fields.err_too_much_data: the edits copy more than {max} JSON values in one activation.
block.edit_fields.err_internal: the message could not be edited safely.
block.edit_fields.err_sample_too_large: The sample is longer than {max} characters.
